done_when: Generated hooks for both hosts run installed Forge guards without executing a replaced project launcher, on setup and upgrade, while existing approval and merge checks remain unchanged

findings.body: When neither Forge nor uvx is available, the new embedded bootstrap prints its installation instructions to stdout and exits 2. The previous launcher sent this diagnostic to stderr. Claude uses stderr as the blocking reason for non-JSON hooks, so its generated hooks now block without showing the explanation or recovery command ([hook contract](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks#exit-code-2)). Restore `>&2` in the shared bootstrap; it generates all four commands for each host.
findings.title: [P2] Write the missing-installation diagnostic to stderr

why: Prevent repository launcher code from running before Forge guards
